personalInfo.summary: Over a million people use software I've built every month, most recently leading the Next.js, Node.js, and React/TypeScript platform behind a major energy company's customer experience and contributing $2M+ in annual revenue. 6+ years as a full-stack engineer, specializing in micro-frontend architecture and performance optimization, with recent work extending into AI-powered product development using Claude APIs. Maintainer of an open-source library trusted by 2+ companies.

highlights: Constructed IJAISM, a software-as-a-service platform for academic publishing (Next.js, React, Prisma, PostgreSQL) – from peer review automation and ORCID login to payment gateways (Stripe/PayPal) and a complete CI/CD pipeline.
Built multi-tenant platform for retail operations including rule-based anomaly detection, 2FA, automated payroll processing, and RBAC permissions management for multiple companies/stores.

Possesses end to end ownership of the stack - API development, third party integrations, CI/CD pipelines and production deployment - both as an enterprise engineer and a solo founder. Designed a full-stack real-time ASL translation service which involved the use of React, Next.js, Node.js and Python/Flask, Media Pipe hand tracking and WebRTC video chat integration.
Gesture recognition using computer vision and CI/CD pipeline including security scan (Trivy, CodeQL) via Docker and Kubernetes deployment.
Modernized the DTE Energy public facing frontend by building a React 18 + TypeScript PWA that scored 95+ in Lighthouse at 1M+ MAU and generated $2M+ ARR.
Picked Module Federation over a shared monorepo, allowing three separate teams to ship independently; reduced cloud costs 30% for annual savings of $180K.
Built Go backend services for real-time energy monitoring data pipeline in addition to Node.js, leveraging Go's concurrency paradigm to deal with high-throughput, low-latency feed ingestion.

Built a Storybook + TypeScript component library which saved 40% on UI development effort and made it possible to release 2 major versions a quarter; open-sourced library downloaded 500+ times a week by 12+ companies.
Optimized frontend bundle size by 28% via Webpack/Vite profiling, code splitting, and lazy loading; ensured full component implementation of WCAG 2.1 guidelines.
Built the GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline from scratch, reducing release times from 45 to 8 minutes (82% improvement) while supporting daily deployments by 3 teams.
Created an A/B testing solution with Jotai instead of Redux due to constantly changing states of experiments; increased sprint testing capacity by 40% at 1M+ scale.
Mentored 8 engineers in 3 time zones; all got promoted in 18 months, while team velocity increased by 35% and retention was 95%.

Developed a JSON-based micro-frontend application that can fully define an entire website with a JSON payload and render it in React, which allows a single PM to deploy 1,000+ websites with no frontend engineer input at all.
Built a React SVG modifier library in the browser (Storybook) for our physical security design teams, helping close $500K+ worth of enterprise deals.
Built REST/GraphQL APIs (compatible with Open API spec) for 8 client-side applications processing 50K+ daily requests at 99.8% availability with p95 <120ms; reduced dB calls by 35% via Redis caching.
Created a Tailwind CSS & Radix UI component library which reduced cross-browser issues by 60%, avoiding one complete round of quality assurance testing per release.
Scalable Module Federation setup for 8 dev teams (from 2) saving $90K in annual costs.
Built the new checkout flow on mobile with React and Optimistic UI, improving conversion rate by 35%, increasing Lighthouse score from around 65 to 90+, and decreasing cart abandonment rate by 22%.
Scaled Laravel-based REST API by 3X, reducing response time by 20% and increasing throughput by 30% without any downtime.
Mobile checkout process re-designed for the two biggest B2C e-commerce sites in Bangladesh — increase in conversions by 35% and drop-in cart abandonment rate by 22%.
Architecture of Laravel product search API optimized to decrease the response time by 20% — no down-time during Black Friday traffic surges.
PWA deployed using the same codebase for web and mobile with more than 90% Lighthouse score — made it possible to deploy to three channels with one effort.
Conceived and implemented a JavaScript library with reusable components, used in 4 internal projects and saving time by 30% in development.
Made an interface between front-end and Laravel REST APIs for several client-side modules, managing both the request and response cycles.
Created 3 web apps using production-level code that saved time during developer onboarding period.
